text: The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines is the supreme law of the land. It establishes the democratic and republican state where sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them. Legislative power is vested in the Congress of the Philippines, consisting of the Senate and the House of Representatives.

The Senate is composed of twenty-four Senators elected at large by qualified voters of the Philippines. The House of Representatives is composed of not more than two hundred and fifty members, unless otherwise fixed by law, who are elected from legislative districts and through the party-list system.

Republic Act No. 6713, known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, establishes the high standards of ethics in government. Section 4 enumerates core norms including commitment to public interest, professionalism, justness, political neutrality, responsiveness, and nationalism.

Public office is a public trust. Public officers and employees must at all times be accountable to the people, serve them with utmost responsibility, integrity, loyalty, and efficiency, act with patriotism and justice, and lead modest lives.

Ang pagsusulit sa Talasalitaan ay sumusukat sa kakayahang unawain ang kahulugan ng mga salita batay sa pagkakagamit sa pangungusap. Ang salitang marikit ay nangangahulugang maganda, marilag, o kaakit-akit sa paningin.
Ang wastong gamit ng ng at nang: Ginagamit ang 'ng' bilang pantukoy ng layon o tagaganap, at 'nang' bilang pang-abay na sumasagot sa tanong na paano, gaano, o kailan.
Percentage and ratio word problems are solved by translating verbal statements into mathematical equations. If 30% of a number N equals 45, then N = 45 / 0.3 = 150. Finding 50% yields 0.5 * 150 = 75.

Deductive reasoning evaluates arguments where conclusions follow necessarily from stated premises. A valid deductive argument guarantees the truth of the conclusion if all premises are true. If premises are empirically true as well, the argument is sound.
